name: branding-blobby-scratched-mookie-wordmark-on-tee-embroidery-and-cafe-window
title: Melting black MOOKIE wordmark with hatched scratches, as chenille tee patch and a giant white window decal on a cafe
whatItIs: A white slide with a fat, melting wordmark 'mookie' filled with fine white hatching, a caption 'mookie espresso bar' and two photos: a person in a white tee with a fuzzy black chenille version on the back and a wooden cafe facade with a giant white decal in the window and the hours '08–00 | 22–00' on the door.
whatItMeans: Cosy and mischievous; blobby scribbly letters feel like a friendly neighbourhood coffee spot.
techniques: Stitch it as a chenille patch.
Use it huge on the window in white.

vocabulary.definition: Fine scratch lines inside a shape.
A vinyl graphic applied to glass.
